verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no in-product feature that generates AI insights or suggestions from a user's data. Metrics Explorer is manual analysis. Autotune AI is automated bandit allocation of variants, not insight generation. The MCP server and ChatGPT integration bring Statsig into external AI tools rather than providing AI insights inside the product, so these are adjacent features only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Autotune and Autotune AI automatically weigh explore versus exploit to deliver the best-performing variant for a single metric.
Talk to your Statsig projects from within ChatGPT.
